description: Create SUPABASE_BLOG_SETUP.md containing the full SQL DDL and setup instructions for the blogs table, blog_categories table, RLS policies, and blog-media storage bucket. This file must be committed to the repo so the admin can run it once against the Supabase project.
steps: Step 1 in doc: SQL DDL for blog_categories table (id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid(), name text not null, slug text not null unique, created_at timestamptz default now())

Step 2 in doc: SQL DDL for blogs table (id uuid pk, title text not null, slug text unique not null, excerpt text, category text, author text, featured_image_url text, content text, status text default 'draft' check(status in ('draft','published','scheduled')), published_at timestamptz, scheduled_at timestamptz, created_at timestamptz default now(), updated_at timestamptz default now(), tags text[], featured boolean default false)

Step 3 in doc: Enable RLS on both tables. Four policies: (a) SELECT on blogs WHERE status='published' for anon, (b) SELECT on blog_categories for anon (true), (c) ALL on blogs for authenticated, (d) ALL on blog_categories for authenticated. Also add a set_updated_at() trigger function + trigger on blogs.
Step 4 in doc: Create blog-media storage bucket — Supabase Dashboard → Storage → New bucket → name 'blog-media' → enable Public → Create.
Step 5 in doc: Set Storage policies — allow authenticated INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on blog-media; public SELECT already granted by public bucket flag.

Step 6 in doc: Seed default categories SQL: INSERT INTO blog_categories (name, slug) VALUES ('Skincare','skincare'),('Hair Care','hair-care'),('Lifestyle','lifestyle'),('Behind the Scenes','behind-the-scenes'),('Tutorials','tutorials') ON CONFLICT (slug) DO NOTHING;
Include note: This file is a setup guide only; it does not run automatically.
acceptance_criteria: SUPABASE_BLOG_SETUP.md exists at the workspace root
The file contains complete, copy-pasteable SQL DDL for both tables with all columns and constraints as specified
The file contains all four RLS policies in SQL form
The file contains the updated_at trigger function and trigger
The file contains the seed INSERT for 5 default categories
The file contains step-by-step UI instructions for creating the blog-media bucket
verification: Open SUPABASE_BLOG_SETUP.md in a text editor and confirm all sections are present
Copy the SQL DDL block into Supabase SQL editor and confirm it executes without errors (manual step performed by admin)
findings: All acceptance criteria met. SUPABASE_BLOG_SETUP.md created at workspace root with complete DDL for both tables, all four RLS policies, set_updated_at() trigger, seed INSERT for 5 default categories, step-by-step UI instructions for the blog-media storage bucket, and SQL storage policies for authenticated INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE. NOTE: The workspace has no .git directory so git commit could not be performed; the file is saved on disk and ready to be committed once the repo is initialised or the worktree is connected.
